budget.calibration_cost: Prior calibration excluded; calibration reference retained.

conditions.gate_scope: Per-round candidate versus pre-transfer incumbent on separate gate conditions. Deployed is a diagnostic selected report, not a separately trained longitudinal branch.
conditions.metric_scope: Endpoint cost, beta_N tracking and temperature-profile RMSE are separate. Checkpoint competence is not shots-to-competence or cold-start efficacy.
conditions.source_cost_scope: Two donors each train four shots once per configuration and seed. Frozen donor replay supplies newly fitted common-base updates each round; donor policies do not receive the aggregate.
conditions.training_schedule: simultaneous TD3 and SAC updates; 30 windows per shot
conditions.transfer_scope: One-way repeated transfer pilot; each strategy keeps its own common-base history and continuing raw target. Actors, replay, heads, entropy and optimizers stay local.
conditions.transport_scope: Real role-matched aggregate_variants in process; no Flower client/server or network-transport validation.

limitations: Development pilot only; one to three seeds and one to two rounds cannot establish efficacy.
Fresh initialization, not resumption of active experiment checkpoints.
Tiny simultaneous-update schedule differs from the main alternating training study.
Raw policy continues after a gate rejection; deployed summaries are per-round diagnostics.
No magnetic-island suppression, mirror steering or real-reactor safety claim.

reference.scope: observed fixed-command endpoint; not whole-trajectory feasibility
